name: ProdvanceAI – Modern Advanced AI Product Search for WooCommerce
author: TeamMWS

sections.description:
ProdvanceAI – Modern Advanced AI Product Search for WooCommerce brings next-generation, AI-enhanced product search to your WooCommerce store.
Deliver instant, intelligent, and highly relevant search results with smart algorithms, live Ajax results, and deep product field scanning.

This plugin integrates seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg, and all major page builders — ensuring you can place your smart search bar anywhere you like.

With its AI-ready architecture, your customers experience modern, human-like product discovery in milliseconds.

⚡ Main Features

Packed with advanced features for powerful, flexible, and intelligent WooCommerce search.

🔍 Search in Product Fields

Search across all major WooCommerce product data to ensure no result is missed:
✅ Product Title
✅ Product Description and Short Description
✅ Product Categories and Tags
✅ Product SKU and ID
✅ Product Brands
✅ Unique identifiers like GTIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN
✅ Custom product meta fields (configurable)

🤖 AI-Powered & Intelligent Search

✅ AI Search Logic: Smarter context-based matching using advanced search algorithms.
✅ Fuzzy Matching: Handles typos and near matches automatically.
✅ Synonyms Recognition: Define related terms for more flexible search results.
✅ Stop Words Control: Exclude meaningless terms for cleaner results.
✅ Plural & Singular Support: Matches both forms accurately.
✅ Relevance Ordering: Results prioritized by search intent and field importance.

⚙️ Live Ajax Search

✅ Displays instant results as users type.
✅ Shows product image, price, SKU, and short description in dropdowns.
✅ Works smoothly with thousands of products.
✅ Lightweight, fast, and optimized for mobile devices.

🧩 Elementor & Page Builder Integration

  • Elementor Widget: Easily add AI-powered search forms using drag-and-drop.
  • Compatible with:
    • Elementor
    • Gutenberg
    • WPBakery
    • Beaver Builder
    • Divi
    • Bricks
    • Oxygen
    • Breakdance
    • Avada
    • Flatsome UX Builder and many more…

💡 User Experience Enhancements

✅ Highlight matched search terms.
✅ Control number of results displayed.
✅ Auto-sync product changes (no manual reindexing).
✅ Fully responsive and mobile-optimized.
✅ Option to replace the default WooCommerce search box in one click.

📊 Analytics & Insights

  • Google Analytics Support: Track search activity directly in your analytics dashboard.

🛠️ Administration & Customization

✅ User-friendly settings panel with detailed configuration options.
✅ Clean, optimized codebase for minimal performance impact.
✅ Developer-friendly hooks and filters for easy customization.

🌐 Multilingual Ready

✅ Compatible with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, and GTranslate.
✅ Fully supports multilingual search and diacritical marks.

🧠 Why Choose ProdvanceAI

✅ Modern, AI-powered search experience for WooCommerce
✅ Real-time, intelligent results with fuzzy and synonym support
✅ Elementor widgets for easy placement
✅ Boosts conversions by helping users find products faster
✅ Built for speed, accuracy, and flexibility

📦 Installation

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to ProdvanceAI Product Search to configure options.
  4. Use the shortcode or Elementor widget to add the search form anywhere.

🔖 Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes anywhere in posts, pages, or widgets:

  • [mpsfw_search_form] — Displays the product search form.

🧱 Elementor Widgets

  • ProdvanceAI Search Form Widget: Add an intelligent, live search box anywhere in your Elementor design.

🧾 Changelog

1.0.2

  • Added DIVI widgets for AI-powered product search.
  • Minor performance and UI enhancements.

1.0.1

  • Added Elementor widgets for AI-powered product search.
  • Improved fuzzy search, synonyms, and typo correction.
  • Optimized relevance ranking for more accurate results.
  • Minor performance and UI enhancements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with full WooCommerce live search functionality.

🧰 Upgrade Notice

= 1.0.1 =
Added Elementor widgets and improved AI search relevance. Recommended update for best results.
